question: R is the father of P, P is the sister of Q, Q is the grandson of T, S is the only child of M, M is married to T, R is married to S. How is S related to P?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/496368278e51fd33f2bee9b301a733a33389bdc9d0f2d4fae5af0b40056affd1.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/766b68022f6e5e305e7188956e1bd6567270587e0e92c179ac060c8346909a3c.png] 

Clearly, S is the mother of P.

Hence, ‘**Mother**’ is the correct answer.
